name: 5 · Rooftop Ruckus
rule_text: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles.

levels.title: 5-01 · Stairs Not Included
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Establish economy and cover all five lanes.
levels.joke: The welcome mat says hello, not all-you-can-eat. The elevator is out; so is common sense. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-02 · Solar Panels Not Included
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Build sun production before doubling your shooters.
levels.joke: Sunlight remains free. The zombie subscription is harder to cancel. The pigeons have delegated all liability to management. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Local traffic cone promoted to middle management. The roof warranty specifically excludes giant clubs. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: The doctor recommends more brains. Seek a second opinion. The chimney sweep has interpreted clean-up as demolition. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-05 · Courier Takes the Lift
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Your delivery is three lanes away and marked delivered. A penthouse view apparently includes incoming zombies. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-06 · Roots on the Roof
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Lose no more than 3 plants to attacks or shoveling. Single-use plants do not count.
levels.joke: The roots have formed a union. Please keep them alive. The pigeons have delegated all liability to management. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.joke: The mowers have requested a mental-health day. A penthouse view apparently includes incoming zombies. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-08 · Pigeon Traffic Control
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Turn signals are apparently a living-person feature. The roof warranty specifically excludes giant clubs. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-09 · Emergency Roof Reserve
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Hold 4000 unspent sun and clear all waves. Collection continues after the last zombie. The accountant also forbids losing more than 8 plants.
levels.joke: Four thousand sun in savings. Still cannot afford a garden shed. The chimney sweep has interpreted clean-up as demolition. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-10 · Twenty Rooftop Pots
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Win with at most 20 planting actions, including grafts and rafts.
levels.joke: Twenty plants. Infinite unsolicited gardening opinions. The elevator is out; so is common sense. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 5-11 · Interns on the Fire Escape
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Clear the fast waves within 380 seconds.
levels.joke: An internship with excellent exposure and no pulse. The elevator is out; so is common sense. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-12 · The Pigeon Union
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Cover the specialist wave; avoid relying on a single front wall. Specialists bill hourly: at most 30 planting actions.
levels.joke: This wave has read the terms and conditions. You have not. The pigeons have delegated all liability to management. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 5-13 · Five Falling Flowerpots
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Lose no more than 5 plants. Transformations and deliberate single-use plants are exempt.
levels.joke: Five losses are a tragedy. Six are a failed level. The chimney sweep has interpreted clean-up as demolition. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-14 · Construction Permit Pending
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Dark crossed tiles cannot be planted. Zombies still travel through them.
levels.joke: These tiles are reserved for a future parking lot. The pigeons have delegated all liability to management. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-15 · Graft Above the Clouds
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Create at least 2 grafts and clear the waves. Same-plant twin hybrids count too.
levels.joke: Botany: now with legally questionable welding. A penthouse view apparently includes incoming zombies.

levels.title: 5-16 · Anti-Air Salad Battery
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. No plants or seeds required. Click a board tile to fire a free recharging area cannon.
levels.joke: No plants today. The salad has authorized artillery. The elevator is out; so is common sense.

levels.title: 5-17 · Rooftop Cafe
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. The supplied seed menu is fixed. Supplies are borrowed even if not yet unlocked.
levels.joke: The chef insists the menu is a tactical constraint. The roof warranty specifically excludes giant clubs.

levels.title: 5-18 · Seeds in Carry-On
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Fixed five-seed deck (graft two Pod Shooters into a Twin Pod for double fire) and a total limit of 24 planting actions.
levels.joke: The seeds were packed by a minimalist. A penthouse view apparently includes incoming zombies.

levels.title: 5-19 · Bucket Under a Leak
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Armor soaks projectiles. Save explosives for tightly grouped helmets.
levels.joke: Buckets protect brains, not fragile workplace morale. The chimney sweep has interpreted clean-up as demolition. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-20 · Special Delivery Upstairs
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Summoners and small runners require rear coverage, not just one front tank.
levels.joke: Fresh interns have arrived. Their onboarding is your problem. The roof warranty specifically excludes giant clubs. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-21 · Save the Roof Garden
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. No planting; lose no more than 5 plants. A mature garden is provided. Protect it; click a damaged plant for a free 1200-HP repair every 3 seconds. Crafted tools are optional.
levels.joke: The garden is already planted. Your job description says keep it that way. The elevator is out; so is common sense.

levels.title: 5-22 · Forty-Five Hundred Skylights
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Collect a total of 4500 sun in this battle. Spending does not reduce this total.
levels.joke: Collect 4000 sun. Do not stare directly at the counter. The pigeons have delegated all liability to management. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-23 · Night on the Tiles
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. No sky sun. Start from the supplied savings and plant your own economy.
levels.joke: Solar power at night: accounting would like a word. The roof warranty specifically excludes giant clubs.

levels.title: 5-24 · Rush Hour on the Roof
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Long mixed assault. Pace your economy: the waves never stop being polite about it.
levels.joke: The committee has decided to attack simultaneously. The chimney sweep has interpreted clean-up as demolition. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 5-25 · Furnace on the Fire Escape
levels.briefing: Announced gusts push zombies back in one lane. Construction blocks some tiles. Two giant arrivals with a rebuilding window. Counter its special ability, then clear the field.
levels.joke: The giant brought a club. The homeowners association brought a fine. A penthouse view apparently includes incoming zombies. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.
